# Confluence Page Tree Creator Skill

Description: Manages hierarchical parent-child documentation pages in Confluence.

Instructions:
1. Ensure root page `[PROJECT] Automated Documentation Sync Pipeline` exists in space `${CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY}`.
2. Nest the specified child page (`01-Requirements Spec`, `02-System Architecture`, etc.) underneath the root page.
3. Update content if the page already exists; create it if missing.
